model_annotation: Figure 2 is a grouped vertical bar chart illustrating negative log-probabilities for clinically relevant tokens, contrasting a baseline model (labeled “Mistral-v0.2-Base”) with versions “Fine-tuned on” different specialty data. The horizontal axis contains six category groups labeled, from left to right, Cardio, Gastro, Infect, Neuro, Obstetric, and Pediatrics (serving as per-specialty term groups), with the axis label reading “Per-specialty terms.” The vertical axis is labeled “Negative log prob.” and shows a numeric scale with tick labels at approximately 22, 23, 24, 25, 26, and 27 (linear scale, increasing downward as displayed). In each category group there are multiple thin bars: a light blue bar for the baseline and several brown/orange bars corresponding to fine-tuned variants (as indicated by the legend), arranged side-by-side within each specialty group. Visually, most bars across groups fall between roughly 22 and 27 on the y-axis, with several bars extending near the lower end around 26–27 and others nearer the upper end around 22–23; no individual bars are annotated with exact values, and there is no apparent sorting beyond the fixed left-to-right specialty order. There is no stacking, and no bars appear specially emphasized beyond color coding by model condition.
